sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: The use of DMT modulation in xDSL systems and its high CF make the line driver the power bottleneck for a CO modem. A SOPA technique is used to create a highly efficient line driver. In this paper, two SOPAs are presented: a zeroth-order and a third-order version.
